output.method: contact-point detection + sphere Hertz/Sneddon modulus fit (scipy)
output.note: DEMO MODE: Real AFM force-curve analysis: contact point from the baseline-noise rise, then a Hertz (sphere) / Sneddon (cone) least-squares fit for Young's modulus E in SI units. Adhesion = retract-minimum below baseline. ν=0.5 (incompressible) is the standard cell assumption. Curve is synthetic with a known modulus (ground_truth_modulus_kpa).
